old_caption: The video showcases a static overhead view of a wooden floor where a large mosaic of the BMW logo is constructed from dominoes. The logo, formed by black, white, and blue dominoes in a circular pattern with "BMW" at the top, is surrounded by a border of multicolored dominoes. The camera remains stationary, and the dominoes are in their initial upright position. The mosaic begins to topple from the bottom-left corner, with dominoes falling in a chain reaction that progresses outward and upward, gradually collapsing the structure.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a wooden floor where a large, intricate mosaic is being created using colorful dominoes. The mosaic features the iconic BMW logo, composed of black, white, and blue tiles arranged in a circular pattern with the letters "BMW" prominently displayed at the top. Surrounding the central logo, there is a border made up of smaller, multicolored dominoes forming a square frame. As the video progresses, the camera remains stationary, focusing on the detailed process of placing each domino piece to complete the design. The scene captures the meticulous arrangement of the dominoes, highlighting the precision and care taken in creating the artwork. The video emphasizes the transformation from an incomplete to a fully formed mosaic, showcasing the skill and patience involved in such a creative endeavor.
caption: The video showcases a fixed high-angle view of a light wood floor, where a square field of standing white dominoes displays a pixel-art BMW roundel bordered by rainbow lines. For the first second, the arrangement remains static, with every domino standing upright and the logo fully intact. A collapse then begins at the bottom-left corner of the white square, where a small patch of dominoes tips over and lies flat. The fallen region grows steadily, spreading rightward along the bottom row and upward along the left column to produce an expanding triangular zone of flattened pieces. The collapse front then reaches the logo, progressively knocking over the lower-left arc of the black ring and intruding into the inner circle's lower-left quadrant. Throughout this ongoing process, the top half of the logo, the right side of the field, and the outer rainbow borders remain upright.

review_issues.problem: The images show a high-angle perspective view of the floor, not a true top-down view.
There is no separate mat; the square is a field of standing dominoes.
The visibly flattened inner-circle area is the lower-left quadrant; implying both left quadrants are knocked over overstates the visible damage.
“Unchanged” is an absolute claim not fully supported because fallen pieces can occlude nearby standing pieces; the visible evidence supports that they remain upright.
